transcript: That day, a special exhibition was being held at the museum Valuable paintings brought from Europe were being exhibited in Japan for the first time At the entrance I bought a ticket and walked along the route In the first room, portraits from the fifteenth century were on display The faces of kings and nobles painted with a primitive yet powerful brushstroke The next room held impressionist paintings Monet, Renoir, Degas Attempts to capture the light appeared Each with the personality of its artist I stopped before one painting And gazed at it for a long time Other visitors passed by Whispering Something the painting awakened Remained with me A female guide was explaining the historical background of the paintings to newly arrived students They were eagerly taking notes When I left the museum I carried a profound satisfaction In my heart Art, across time and place, quietly brings relief to the heart of the viewer It is not a luxury, but one of the forms of nourishment that human beings need you

segments.text: That day, a special exhibition was being held at the museum
Valuable paintings brought from Europe were being exhibited in Japan for the first time
At the entrance I bought a ticket and walked along the route
In the first room, portraits from the fifteenth century were on display
The faces of kings and nobles painted with a primitive yet powerful brushstroke
The next room held impressionist paintings
Monet, Renoir, Degas
Attempts to capture the light appeared
Each with the personality of its artist
I stopped before one painting
And gazed at it for a long time
Other visitors passed by
Whispering
Something the painting awakened
Remained with me
A female guide was explaining the historical background of the paintings to newly arrived students
They were eagerly taking notes
When I left the museum
I carried a profound satisfaction
In my heart
Art, across time and place, quietly brings relief to the heart of the viewer
It is not a luxury, but one of the forms of nourishment that human beings need
you
